content.title: Compare savings account products
content.description: A prospective customer reviews the savings products offered on the Open Account page before entering personal data, sees each product’s APY and minimum opening deposit up front, and can rely on High-Yield Savings being preselected while still changing the choice to another highlighted product.
content.summary: Review and compare available savings products.
content.value: Lets visitors make an informed product choice before beginning the application.
criteria: the Open Account page offers exactly three products: High-Yield Savings, Everyday Savings, and Money Market

product terms shown up front are High-Yield Savings 4.34% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, Everyday Savings 3.10% APY with $0 minimum opening deposit, and Money Market 4.00% APY with $100 minimum opening deposit
all three savings products are fee-free and their APY and minimum opening deposit are shown before personal data is requested
High-Yield Savings is selected by default on page load, and changing the product highlights the chosen option
